purpose: Diagnose whether the frozen Waymo encoder's nuPlan longitudinal dose sensitivity is driven by ego kinematics, neighbor context, or handcrafted interaction summaries before any retraining or lane-pipeline change.

representations.definition: Existing frozen Stage 6J/K 64D embeddings; no recomputation or rescaling.
Run the same frozen encoder after preserving context_traj channels 0:8 and setting all five neighbor-slot channels 8:83 to zero at every timestep.

formula.accel: first difference of valid-frame speed divided by dt; first sample repeats the first finite difference convention as zero
formula.jerk: first difference of recomputed accel divided by dt; first sample zero
formula.yaw_rate: wrapped first difference of ego_seq channel 4 divided by dt; first sample zero
formula.path_length: sum Euclidean displacement of valid-frame ego_seq x/y

representations.definition: Concatenate the frozen 13D ego kinematic summary with all 33 mask-aware interaction_feat_style features in feature_schema order.

statistics.bandwidth: exact pooled positive off_diagonal median independently within each representation x dose x scope
statistics.log_cluster_randomization: all scenario pairs sharing log_name flip together
statistics.overall_holm_family: four nonzero doses separately within each representation
statistics.task_holm_family: four doses x three frozen Stage 6J tasks separately within each representation
statistics.log_cluster_holm_family: four nonzero doses separately within each representation

geometric_only_supplement.reason: Run only after A-D diagnostics because rebuilding the lane assignment changes the context construction path and is a supplementary stress test, not the first representation ablation.

retraining_go_only_if_any: learned64_full_context is materially less null-standardized-sensitive than ego_kinematic_13d across the frozen dose curve
neighbor-zero ablation preserves most sensitivity while full-context distance remains quality-associated
handcrafted representation shows robust task sensitivity that learned64 misses
go_no_go.context_v2_go_only_if: full-context sensitivity or pair contribution remains materially associated with lane quality after the A-D diagnostic
go_no_go.no_go_for_immediate_retraining: Do not retrain solely because raw BDD values are numerically small.
